C1344.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Faces New Challenge: Breakthrough in Lattice-Based Cryptanalysis
C1344.summary: On January 1, 2026, a team led by Ding Jintai at Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University solved the 210-dimensional Shortest Vector Problem in the SVP Challenge hosted by TU Darmstadt, setting a new record (after solving 200 dimensions in March 2025). Around 400 dimensions is the threshold at which mainstream post-quantum cryptographic schemes could face breakage; the successive 200- and 210-dimensional breakthroughs signal major advances in lattice cryptanalysis, providing critical reference for dynamic tuning and autonomous design of post-quantum algorithm parameters.
